fields.why: Table 2 gives PRs for three FPL levels against the >=400% referent, and Table 1 gives a Wald chi-square p-value and PR for each level of age, race/ethnicity, parent education, rurality and FPL.
FPL (4) and parent education (3) are SES, child age has 3 bands, race/ethnicity 4 groups, and RUCA urban/rural 4 levels describing children's residence; sex and language have 2.
Table 1 p-values differ by row, so each level is tested against the rest (MBDD vs no MBDD), not one omnibus test per variable; Table 2 marks each PR against the >=400% referent.
